section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body, Eating, and Exercise Comparison Orientation Measure (BEECOM), a 18-item instrument with three six-item subscales assessing social comparison frequency across body, eating, and exercise dimensions. The text reports internal consistency (Cronbach's alpha values of .90, .89, and .91 for the three subscales in the current study) and references prior validation among undergraduate students. No specific study numbers, sample characteristics, or outcome correlations are provided in this section.
